verdict.rationale: Runloop documents running arbitrary commands inside Devboxes through command execution, stateful named shells, an interactive PTY and SSH. Package installation is only implied: blueprints built from a Dockerfile and reusable startup actions suggest it, but no evidence explicitly shows installing packages (e.g. apt or pip) inside a running sandbox. missing for 10: explicit documentation of package installation inside a devbox (apt/pip/npm), detail on what commands are permitted or restricted, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run arbitrary shell commands and install packages inside the sandbox

citations.quote: Run and execute code at scale
Use stateful named shells to maintain environment and working directory across commands
Open an interactive pseudo-terminal on a Devbox for TUIs, REPLs, and shells that need a real TTY
choose **SSH** to open a secure shell session directly into your devbox
Blueprints allow you to optimize your workflows by specifying these startup actions once, then reuse them across multiple Devboxes.
